name: Adaptive Gaussian Selector
definition: A learnable module that adaptively selects a subset of 3D Gaussians based on their attributes and a desired elastic ratio e, using a differentiable mask to enable gradient-based optimization.
summary: The Adaptive Gaussian Selector is a learnable module that adaptively selects 3D Gaussians using differentiable Gumbel-Softmax sampling, enabling gradient-based optimization unlike non-differentiable thresholding methods.
